query: john x morris, 2020, emnlp, university of virginia, textattack a framework for adversarial attacks data augmentation and adversarial training in nlp
sql:
SELECT
  p.corpus_id,
  p.title,
  p.abstract,
  p.canonical_venue,
  p.venue,
  p.year,
  p.citation_count
FROM Papers p
JOIN PaperAuthors pa ON p.corpus_id = pa.corpus_id
JOIN Authors a ON pa.author_id = a.author_id
LEFT JOIN AuthorInstitutions ai ON a.author_id = ai.author_id
LEFT JOIN Institutions i ON ai.institution_id = i.institution_id
WHERE
  p.year = 2020
  AND p.canonical_venue ILIKE '%EMNLP%'
  AND p.venue_type = 'main'
  AND a.name ILIKE '%john%morri%'
  AND (
    i.display_name ILIKE '%university of virginia%'
    OR i.display_name ILIKE '%univ. of virginia%'
    OR i.display_name ILIKE '%uva%'
  )
  AND (
    p.title ILIKE '%textattack%'
    OR p.title ILIKE '%adversarial attack%'
    OR p.title ILIKE '%data augmentation%'
    OR p.title ILIKE '%adversarial training%'
    OR p.abstract ILIKE '%textattack%'
    OR p.abstract ILIKE '%adversarial attack%'
    OR p.abstract ILIKE '%data augmentation%'
    OR p.abstract ILIKE '%adversarial training%'
  )
ORDER BY
  (CASE WHEN p.title ILIKE 'textattack: a framework for adversarial attacks, data augmentation, and adversarial training in nlp%' THEN 3
        WHEN p.title ILIKE 'textattack: a framework for adversarial attacks, data augmentation, and adversarial training in nlp%' THEN 2
        WHEN p.title ILIKE '%textattack%' THEN 1
        ELSE 0
  END) DESC,
  p.citation_count DESC
LIMIT 100

  p.corpus_id,
  p.title,
  p.abstract,
